svg.title: Deployment with hylo-serve
svg.desc: Three machines. The workstation runs Studio and holds the store. The robot computer runs hylo serve workcell: a real-time runner, the SafetyShield, the operator channel and the robot adapter, which drives the arm. A GPU box runs hylo serve policy, which follows a campaign's promoted version. Studio talks to the workcell over HTTP, the workcell to the policy server over a WebSocket, and recorded runs go to the store.
